findings.description: This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects such as the uploaded vendor roster may be stored without an explicitly enforced encryption policy, exposing data if storage is accessed improperly.
This bucket does not enforce server-side encryption through a bucket encryption configuration. Ledger export data can therefore be stored without explicitly configured encryption at rest.
This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so model artifacts are not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest setting.
This bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Runbook content could be stored without explicitly enforced encryption at rest.

The bucket is configured for log delivery and encryption but has no public-access-block resource or equivalent access-control policy shown. ACLs or bucket policies could permit public exposure, including through future changes; the configuration does not explicitly block public access.
